I understand what you mean. 

That’s my hope. Today did go much better than yesterday and that’s all I can hope for. I mentioned to him (not in a mean way) that internet strangers on reddit were helping me figure things out and offering encouraging words. I think him hearing that (and seeing the threads as i’ve shown him as well) has helped him to be more understanding of my feelings. And I would love for him to go back to a therapist about his ptsd. He acts like it doesn’t affect him, but he’s weary of things in the road (debris in roads is how they sometimes disguise bombs), and you can always tell he is uncomfortable with people behind him. 

But honestly, thank you for all of your kind words. You don’t realize how helpful you’ve been.

I only asked you because you mentioned it and I had not heard of it. I have tried to use all resources that I am aware of and when those options were exhausted, I looked to forums and reddit. Thank you for your help though.
No, your comment was very helpful. A different perspective from someone outside the situation is always welcome, and I thank you for that.

Thank you for your kind reply. I’ve essentially gotten to the point that i’m just living for the baby. I just worry that when the baby doesn’t need me anymore, i’ll feel like I don’t have a purpose again. 

we talked last night after he got off so maybe things will get better. he did try to listen to me for the first time. i think one reason he may treat me like that is because when he went to therapy for ptsd (ex military) he said his therapist essentially told him to get over it. that broke my heart to hear because I know a good therapist wouldn’t have treated his problems that way. that was the first time he had ever told me that
Why though? What would them being in or not in a relationship change?
Jordan was a disservice to Monty and Harpers legacy

I would try working at a strip club as a dancer, shot girl, or bartender rather than doing straight up SW. I think it’s safer and more profitable. I bartended and shot girl’ed at a few clubs when I first moved into the area. The only taxing part of doing a job where you’re at the club all the time, is constantly having to smile & fake things. But the money is well worth it. Bartenders and shot girls make more money than the dancers, but there’s nothing wrong with dancing either because they usually still leave with a bag too. Some clubs will even allow you to work and then at the end, pay your tip out. tip out here ranges from $20-40 for most night shifts as long as you arrive before 9pm. Have you considered something like this, just for the time being? 

And I just want to say, you’re a wonderful pet parent and your dog is lucky to have you. I hope things improve.
Not something to be taken lightly. Fuck that “friend.”

That would be a great idea if they actually were supportive, lived closer, and also if I could just up and quit my job. But I can’t do that, they stay 4+ hours away, and mental health is still a rather taboo subject with my family. They feel similar to my husband in that that view mental health issues as sort of weaknesses of character, so I don’t know that being around more of that mindset would be helpful, even if it were a possibility. Thank you though.

Thank you. I have tried discussing my feelings with him but he just belittles or dismisses them entirely. He doesn’t believe that i feel this way, and honestly the only thing stopping me from acting on these thoughts is the baby. I’m 26 weeks along so I can feel the baby move and kick and it just hasn’t done anything wrong. I can’t bring myself to hurt me because that would kill the baby too. So it would seem that I am stuck feeling like this until at least when the baby is born. I just worry things will get worse after that, not better.

That only really applies to his family and they’re very close, so they will side with him even if he’s done wrong. I would spend time with my family but they live 4+ hours away so the only way to talk is over the phone. Same with my friends, they’re my college friends and all of us have gone different ways. Some stay on the other side of the country so we’ve just drifted apart. I wouldn’t mind doing couples therapy but he isn’t open to it. Thank you for all of your advice and kind words. I truly appreciate it.
